product_title: Handcrafted Pink Lotus Decorative Diya Pair with Golden Mirror Work and Pearl Embellishments
product_description: Illuminate your festive celebrations with this beautiful handcrafted Pink Lotus Decorative Diya Pair. Featuring vibrant hot pink lotus flowers, intricate golden detailing, elegant mirror work, and delicate pearl embellishments, these decorative diya holders add a luxurious and traditional touch to your home decor. The ornate golden base and artistic floral designs create a stunning combination of elegance and festive charm. Perfect for decorating pooja rooms, home temples, entranceways, and festive tables, these diya holders are ideal for Diwali, Lakshmi Puja, weddings, housewarming ceremonies, and other auspicious occasions. Designed to enhance your festive ambiance, this decorative pair beautifully blends traditional Indian artistry with vibrant floral elegance.
product_care_suggestion: Clean gently with a soft, dry cloth to remove dust.
Avoid washing or immersing the product in water to protect the fabric flowers, pearls, and decorative embellishments.
Keep away from excessive moisture and humidity to maintain the golden finish.
Avoid direct sunlight for extended periods to preserve the vibrant pink color.
Do not use harsh chemicals, detergents, or abrasive cleaning materials.
Handle the lotus flowers and pearl embellishments carefully to prevent damage.
Store in a dry place inside a protective box when not in use.
If using with candles or oil lamps, keep the flame away from the fabric flowers, pearls, and other decorative materials. Never leave a burning diya unattended.
